title: A Low-Sugar Siren Now Overlays YouTube, Not Just a Clock | vitalii.no
description:
A low blood sugar alert on a kitchen TV used to only flash red and blue inside one web page. The moment anyone switched that TV stick over to YouTube or any other app, the warning became completely invisible, even while the sugar reading underneath kept dropping.

I built a dedicated SirenService that polls the glucose hub on its own schedule, independent of whatever page or app is on screen, and draws a full-screen flashing overlay directly on top of it. A BootReceiver restarts the service automatically if the TV stick ever reboots, so the alert survives a power cut without anyone touching it. The clock page itself still keeps its own red-and-blue flash as a fallback underneath.

Result: a low-sugar reading now triggers a visible, full-screen flash no matter what is playing on the TV, instead of being silently stuck behind whatever app happened to be open.
